---
title: "Tidy_Recovery_Data"
output: html_document
---

```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)


source("util/helpers.R")
```

```{r data_load}
recovery_data <- load_data("recovery")
```

```{r clean_data_structure}
 recovery_data <- sanitize_data_structure(recovery_data)
```

```{r}
naniar::miss_var_summary(recovery_data)
```
```{r}
no_skin_temp <- recovery_data %>% filter(is.na(score.skin_temp_celsius))
```
Datensatz sieht sonst gut aus -> NA substituieren mit Mittelwert

```{r}
recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
  mutate(score.skin_temp_celsius = 
           replace_na(score.skin_temp_celsius,  median(score.skin_temp_celsius, na.rm = TRUE))) 
```

```{r}
recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
  rename(recovery_hrv = score.hrv_rmssd_milli)
```


```{r feature_engineering}

recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_zone = case_when(
      score.recovery_score <= 33 ~ "red",    
      score.recovery_score <= 66 ~ "yellow", 
      TRUE                       ~ "green"  
    )
  )
```


```{r select_only_relevant_columns}
recovery_data_cleaned <- recovery_data %>%
  select( cycle_id, sleep_id,
         score.recovery_score, score.resting_heart_rate, score.spo2_percentage, 
         recovery_hrv, score.skin_temp_celsius, recovery_zone)
```



```{r store_clean_data}
write_rds(recovery_data_cleaned, file = here("data", "cleaned_recovery_data.rds"))
```
